# ROMX reference fixtures

These deterministic ROMX 0.2.0 files are generated by
`tools/romx_reference.py`. Each `.manifest.json` records the complete expected
footer, derived regions, RIDX header, entries, checksums, and validation status.

- `minimal-single.romx` contains one prefix-free synthetic NES payload with no
  optional entry CRC32, metadata, cover, mutable region, or immutable SHA-256.
- `single-complete.romx` contains the same payload with entry CRC32, metadata,
  a one-pixel PNG cover, an empty 12 KiB mutable region, and immutable SHA-256.
- `multi-cue.romx` contains a CUE entrypoint at offset zero and two directly
  indexed track files. All three entries have CRC32 values.

Regenerate and verify them with:

```sh
python3 tools/romx_reference.py fixtures tests/fixtures --force
python3 tools/romx_reference.py inspect \
  tests/fixtures/single-complete.romx --verify-entry-crc32
```

The synthetic payloads are test data and contain no game content.
